ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $AC$ respectively. If $\angle A=75^\circ$ and $\angle ADE=35^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle A=75^\circ$ and $\angle ADE=35^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AED=180^\circ-\angle A-\angle ADE=70^\circ$,\\
since $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $AC$ respectively, implying that $DE$ is the midline of $\triangle ABC$,\\
thus $DE\parallel BC$,\\
therefore, $\angle C=\angle AED=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
